research_question: At equal official-label budgets, does scene-conditioned acquisition of selection errors improve a frozen planner's trajectory ranking?
authorization: User requested proceeding with the proposed selection-error sampler and small scorer-correction comparison.

preregistered_promotion.primary: C minus A selected PDMS on the locked development recordings has a positive paired recording-bootstrap 95% lower bound
preregistered_promotion.secondary: C selected collision-or-offroad rate does not exceed A by more than one percentage point
preregistered_promotion.scope: One seed pilot; meeting these criteria supports replication, not a publication or independent final-test claim

boundary_baseline: Training-only GT path, drivable-map and future-occupancy geometric margins; no simulator bisection. Inspired baseline, not an exact reproduction of Versatile Samples.
sampler_objective: Supervised family error-reward regression on the common training scout pool; labels use actual utility and soft neural top-selection probabilities. No NAVVAL targets enter sampler training.
evaluation: NAVSIM v1 reference-plus-single-candidate PDMS, fixed native64 and separately fixed nearby64 pools; candidate contexts identical for all rankers
